exposure: Fear for health during COVID-19 pandemic
cohort: The study included 290 hospitalized pregnant women with high-risk pregnancies from the Clinic for Gynaecology and Obstetrics, University Clinical Centre of Serbia.
finding: The Serbian version of the Brief Illness Perception Questionnaire (B-IPQ) demonstrated good reliability and validity for illness perception in high-risk pregnancies, with illness perception significantly correlating with mental health, stress, anxiety, and depression levels, and acting as a predictor of quality of life.
cross-section timing: Data was collected from pregnant women during their hospitalization for high-risk pregnancies.
